summary: The commenter argues for maintaining the current interpretation of CIPA regarding screen time for minors, emphasizing that screen time should not be treated as equivalent to harmful online content. The comment opposes imposing screen-time limits on E-Rate eligibility, arguing that excessive screen time could lead to increased costs for schools and parents and negatively impact the well-being and development of minors. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate to reduce funding for broadband access and internet services in schools and libraries. The Commenter supports tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes to ensure comprehensive training on digital competence for educators and community members.
